Text:
Mangonels don't require setup to fire but require a very short aiming time instead.

Trebuchets have slightly increased range, require longer set up time to fire and only target buildings. Use attack ground ability to attack anything else.

All civs have pop cap of 400 for Normal, Empire and Nomad modes and start with a base population of 40 apart from Mongols who start with 400.

To balance civilians with military, all villagers, trade caravans cost 2 pop, trade ships cost 4 pop.

All non navy units have been scaled to 80% of their regular size.

All rams now only hold 8 units inside instead of 16.

English Wonder can now spawn Archbishop which can covert enemies units over a longer range without use of a relic.

Support unit with no combat capability. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites.
+ Heals friendly units
- Slow movement speed.
The Archbishop does not require a relic to convert enemies and the range of conversion is increased.
Attempts to convert a single enemy unit within range of this Archbishop to your control.
